lines.text: The psalm calls the servants who stand in the house of the LORD to praise His name because He is good.
The LORD chose Jacob and Israel as His treasured possession, and He does all that pleases Him in heaven, earth and seas.
He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, then struck down Sihon king of the Amorites and Og king of Moab.
The LORD's name endures forever, while idols made by human hands have ears that hear, and those who trust them become like them.

wrong_details.true: idols have ears but cannot hear

lines.text: The psalm calls the houses of Israel, Aaron and Levi to bless the LORD, who dwells in Jerusalem.
